content.title: What building permits are required?
content.summary: Permits are required for all construction. If you are planning on remodeling the kitchen/bathrooms; adding an addition; redoing electrical; mechanical appliances, or plumbing fixtures; re-roofing; rebuilding a deck; or constructing a fence, then a permit is required.

faqs.a: Permits are required for all construction. If you are planning on remodeling the kitchen/bathrooms; adding an addition; redoing electrical; mechanical appliances, or plumbing fixtures; re-roofing; rebuilding a deck; or constructing a fence, then a permit is required.
